许紫烟看到他的速度和气势，就已经知道对方已经用了全力。自己又不好显示出自己的功力，只好更加小心地将自己的修为控制在后天第六层的境界，脚步躲闪间，卸去了对方的力量，和对方周旋了起来。
可是，如此一来，后天六层和后天八层并经差了境界，许紫烟根本就不能够硬接对方的攻势，只能够躲闪，偶尔借力打力。如此一来便落了下风，许紫烟精神高度集中，身形如同穿花蝴蝶，在对方的拳影脚法之间穿梭着。
虽然狼狈，但是刚才在大殿之内所学到的基础知识却从内到外，从灵魂到身体渐渐地完全融会贯通起来。在大殿之内的时候，许紫烟还只是在意识中将所学的东西融会贯通，并没有实际的运用，也就是说还没有身心结合。
如今在一个后天八层的凌厉重压之下，不得不打起十二分的经历，小心地应付。如此一来，却是加速了许紫烟心身的融合。初时许紫烟在对方的压迫之下，狼狈不堪，虽然没有受伤，那是因为许紫烟在躲闪之际已经把修为悄悄地提升到后天七层，只是在攻击的时候，才控制在后天第六层的境界。何况在初时许紫烟被对方压迫的厉害，根本就没有还手的机会。
可是渐渐地，许紫烟真正的融会贯通了。没有了初时的狼狈万分，只是有些狼狈，随着时间的推移，许紫烟不狼狈了。虽然还处于弱势，但是防守却极其严密，躲闪也十分地轻盈。再过了一会儿，许紫烟已经开始能够反击了。
按理说，作为老弟子，在以往一定没有少在大殿之内听课，而且那些授课的老师肯定也讲的一模一样，但是你去听了，却并不等于你领会了。就算是领会了，他也只是领会了后天第八层以下的秘诀，如何会像许紫烟这样完全领会了十二层一下的秘诀？这就是修为不同，所站的高度不同，所看的视角也不相同。
如此一番打斗下来，许紫烟到后来完全凭着后天六层的修为竟然和后天八层的对方战了个平手，而且隐隐地有着反超的局势。
这不仅让周围的新老弟子们心中震惊加不解，就是不远处阁楼上的那些老师同样如此，特别是那位民哥，心中更是狂震不已，他回想起刚才在大殿之中，自己授完可之后，满殿的弟子都是目光茫然，唯独这个目前在场内打斗的女子目光一片清澈。当初自己还以为她根本没有听自己授课，可是看眼前的情况，她根本就不是没有听课，而是将自己所讲的课程完全理解啊！
“那……她可是一个天才啊！”民哥心中不住地思索着，突然心中狂震：“不对，她只有后天六层的修为，怎么能够理解我今天所将的全部？要知道我今天所讲的可是从后天一层到十二层的综述。而且既然说是综述了，就是一个总纲，并不详细，她竟然能够领悟到如此地步，难道她是一个天才？”
这时候，那些和他站在一起的老师们也看得目瞪口呆，许紫烟的行为完全颠覆了他们的以往对修真的认知。眼前的这个女孩竟然能够以弱对强，哦，不对，眼看着就要以弱胜强了。
“民哥，这个女孩不像没有听你讲课的样子啊。”
“是啊，不但不像，似乎还都理解了你讲的东西啊！”
不提这些阁楼上的老师在那里边看边问民哥，这时候场内的许紫烟已经完全地掌握了主动。在对修行的理解上，许紫烟已经超出对方一大截，再加上许紫烟虽然把自己的修为控制在后天第六层，但是她的真是水平却是炼气期第二层。所以她自然要比对方一个后天八层的人持久。
此时的那少年已经没有了初始的锐气，体内的真气消耗的七七八八，攻出的拳脚也已经有些软软绵绵的。心中一个劲诧异：
“眼前的这个女孩是谁啊？怎么后天六层的修为比我这八层的人还持久啊！”
正在想不通之时，心神瞬间的疏忽。他不疏忽都已经落了下风，此时再这么一疏忽，更是破绽大开。许紫烟的一只手掌毫不留情的扇到了他的脸上，耳边只听到：
“啪~~”
空间里留下了一阵回音：“啪~~啪~~啪~~”
那少年一下子就楞在原地，一张脸变得通红。一半是因为被许紫烟一个耳光给打的，另一半是当着这么多人的面被一个女孩扇了一个大耳光羞臊的。可是心里也明白自己不是许紫烟的对手，可是就算不是对手，被对方就这么当众扇了一个响亮的耳光，自己也应该有些举动啊，否则以后自己在外堂怎么混啊！

When Xu Ziyan saw his speed and momentum, he already knew that the other party had used all his strength. It was not easy for me to show off my skills, so I had to be more careful to control my cultivation level at the sixth level of the acquired world. While dodging my steps, I removed the opponent's power and started to deal with the opponent.
However, as a result, the sixth level and the eighth level of the day after tomorrow are different. Xu Ziyan cannot directly take the opponent's offensive. He can only dodge and occasionally use his strength to fight. As a result, Xu Ziyan was at a disadvantage. Xu Ziyan was highly concentrated, and his figure was like a butterfly wearing flowers, shuttling between the opponent's fists, shadows and kicks.
Although he was embarrassed, the basic knowledge he had just learned in the hall was gradually and completely integrated from the inside out, from the soul to the body. While in the hall, Xu Ziyan was only integrating what he had learned in his consciousness without actually applying it, which meant that he had not yet integrated his body and mind.
Now, under the severe pressure of an acquired eighth level, I have to use my experience to deal with it carefully. In this way, it accelerated the fusion of Xu Ziyan's mind and body. At first, Xu Ziyan was in a state of embarrassment under the pressure of the opponent. Although he was not injured, it was because Xu Ziyan had quietly raised his cultivation level to the acquired seventh level when he was dodging, and only when attacking, he was controlled at the acquired sixth level. What's more, Xu Ziyan was so oppressed by the opponent at the beginning that he had no chance to fight back.
But gradually, Xu Ziyan really understood it. There is no longer the initial embarrassment, but just a little embarrassment. As time goes by, Xu Ziyan is no longer in embarrassment. Although he is still weak, his defense is extremely tight and his dodges are also very light. After a while, Xu Ziyan began to be able to fight back.
It stands to reason that as an old disciple, you must have attended many lectures in the hall in the past, and the teachers who taught the lectures must have taught exactly the same thing. However, just because you went to listen, it does not mean that you understood it. Even if he understood it, he only understood the secret of the eighth level and below. How could he completely understand the secret of the twelfth level and below like Xu Ziyan? This means that with different cultivation levels, you stand at different heights and see from different perspectives.
After such a fight, Xu Ziyan ended up with a tie with the opponent on the eighth level, relying entirely on his acquired sixth-level cultivation, and there was a vague overtaking situation.
This not only shocked and puzzled the new and old disciples around, but also the teachers in the attic not far away, especially Brother Min, who was even more shocked. He recalled that in the hall just now, after he had finished teaching, all the disciples in the hall had blank eyes, except for the woman who was currently fighting in the field, her eyes were clear. At first, I thought that she didn't listen to his lecture at all, but looking at the situation in front of me, it was not that she didn't listen to the lecture at all, but that she fully understood the course she taught!
"Then...she is a genius!" Brother Min couldn't help but think in his heart, and suddenly he was shocked: "No, she only has the sixth level of acquired cultivation, how can she understand everything I have learned today? You must know that what I talked about today is a summary from the acquired level to the twelfth level. And since it is a summary, it is a general outline, not detailed. She can actually understand it to such an extent. Is she a genius?"
At this time, the teachers standing with him were also stunned. Xu Ziyan's behavior completely subverted their previous understanding of cultivation. The girl in front of me is actually able to defeat the weak against the strong. Oh, no, the weak is about to defeat the strong.
"Brother Min, it doesn't look like this girl didn't listen to your lecture."
"Yes, not only does it look different, but I seem to understand what you said!"
NoThe teachers in the attic were watching and asking Brother Min. At this time, Xu Ziyan in the field had completely taken the initiative. In terms of understanding of cultivation, Xu Ziyan has surpassed the other party by a large margin. In addition, although Xu Ziyan controls her cultivation level at the sixth level of the day after tomorrow, her real level is at the second level of the Qi refining period. Therefore, she will naturally outlast the other person, who is an acquired eight-level person.
At this time, the young man no longer had the initial vigor, the zhenqi in his body had been depleted, and the fists and kicks he struck were already a bit limp. I was constantly surprised:
"Who is this girl in front of me? How come my acquired sixth-level cultivation lasts longer than someone like me who is on the eighth level!"
When I was confused, my mind was careless for a moment. He was already at a disadvantage even if he was not negligent. If he was so negligent at this time, his flaws would be wide open. One of Xu Ziyan's palms slapped his face mercilessly, and he only heard in his ears:
"Pa~~"
There was an echo left in the space: "Pa~~Pa~~Pa~~"
The young man suddenly froze on the spot, his face turning red. Half of it was because of being slapped by Xu Ziyan, and the other half was because of being embarrassed by being slapped by a girl in front of so many people. But I also know in my heart that I am not Xu Ziyan's opponent, but even if I am not an opponent, I am slapped so loudly in public by the other party, I should also do something, otherwise how can I hang out in the outside hall in the future!
